question: Which of the following rivers flows through Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Betwa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Betwa River** is one of the major rivers flowing through **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• It originates from the **Vindhya range** near Hoshangabad in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The river flows through both **Madhya Pradesh** and **Uttar Pradesh** before merging with the **Yamuna River**.
 
• It spans a length of approximately **590 km**.
 
• The Betwa River is a part of the **Yamuna river system**, making it a significant tributary of the Yamuna.
 
• This river is known for its **hydroelectric and irrigation projects**, such as the **Rajghat Dam** and the **Matatila Dam**.
 
• The Betwa River is of cultural importance as it flows through historic regions like **Orchha** and **Jhansi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shyok River**__

 __
 
• The **Shyok River** is a tributary of the **Indus River**.
 
• It flows through the regions of **Ladakh** in India and parts of **Pakistan**.
 
• It is often referred to as the "**River of Death**" due to the challenging terrain and harsh conditions in its valley.
 
 
 
• **Sharda River**__
 __
 
• The **Sharda River**, also known as the **Mahakali River**, originates in the **Himalayas**.
 
• It forms the international boundary between **India** and **Nepal** in certain stretches.
 
• The Sharda Barrage on this river is a key source of irrigation in **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
 
 
• **Bhima River**__
 
 
• The **Bhima River** is a major tributary of the **Krishna River**.
 
• It flows primarily through the states of **Maharashtra** and **Karnataka**.
 
• It is known for supporting agriculture and being a lifeline for the **Deccan Plateau**.
